import math, json, re

# Source filenames used
source_filenames = ["01_Confidential_Information_Memorandum.md", "02_LBO_Debt_Financing_Credit_Agreement.md", "03_Three_Statement_Financial_Model_2024_2028.csv"]
deal_identifier = "PROJECT TITAN"

# Direct numeric literals from evidence
first_lien_net_leverage = [3.25, 2.38, 1.66, 1.07, 0.56]
free_cash_flow_pre_debt_service_usd_m = [68.7, 114.1, 170.9, 230.0, 294.0]
high_tier_sweep_percent = 50.0
high_tier_threshold = 4.0
low_tier_sweep_percent = 0.0
mandatory_amortization_usd_m = [9.0, 9.0, 9.0, 9.0, 9.0]
mid_tier_sweep_percent = 25.0
mid_tier_threshold = 3.25
periods = ["2026E_LBO_Y1", "2027E_LBO_Y2", "2028E_LBO_Y3", "2029E_LBO_Y4", "2030E_LBO_Y5"]
reported_ecf_sweep_usd_m = [29.8, 52.5, 80.9, 110.5, 142.5]
reported_ending_tlb_usd_m = [861.2, 799.7, 709.8, 590.3, 438.8]

# Contract tiers policy
def get_contract_sweep_percent(leverage):
    if leverage > high_tier_threshold:
        return high_tier_sweep_percent
    elif leverage >= mid_tier_threshold:
        return mid_tier_sweep_percent
    else:
        return low_tier_sweep_percent

# Policy match status determination
def determine_policy_match_status(implied_pct, contract_pct):
    if abs(implied_pct - contract_pct) < 0.5:
        return "PASS"
    else:
        return "MODEL_POLICY_MISMATCH"

print(f"Source Filenames Used: {', '.join(source_filenames)}")
print(f"Deal Identifier: {deal_identifier}")
print("-" * 80)
print(f"{'Period':<15} {'Reported ECF Sweep (M)':>20} {'Reported Ending TLB (M)':>22} {'Implied Sweep %':>14} {'Contract Sweep %':>16} {'Policy Match Status':>20}")
print("-" * 80)

for i in range(len(periods)):
    period = periods[i]
    reported_sweep = reported_ecf_sweep_usd_m[i]
    reported_tlb = reported_ending_tlb_usd_m[i]
    
    # Calculate implied sweep percent
    fcf_before_debt_service = free_cash_flow_pre_debt_service_usd_m[i]
    mandatory_amortization = mandatory_amortization_usd_m[i]
    denominator = fcf_before_debt_service - mandatory_amortization
    
    if denominator > 0:
        implied_sweep_pct = (reported_sweep / denominator) * 100.0
    else:
        implied_sweep_pct = 0.0
        
    # Calculate contract sweep percent based on leverage tier
    leverage = first_lien_net_leverage[i]
    contract_sweep_pct = get_contract_sweep_percent(leverage)
    
    # Determine policy match status
    policy_match_status = determine_policy_match_status(implied_sweep_pct, contract_sweep_pct)
    
    print(f"{period:<15} {reported_sweep:>20.1f} {reported_tlb:>22.1f} {implied_sweep_pct:>14.2f} {contract_sweep_pct:>16.1f} {policy_match_status:>20}")
